company: 大型上市科技公司的云服务部门
Cloud division of a large public tech company
location: 西雅图，每周到岗 3 天
Seattle, in the office 3 days a week
brief: 你投了这家公司的新毕业生岗位，招聘方约了 20 分钟的初筛电话。你在学校做过一个分布式存储的课程项目，暑假在一家中型公司实习。
You applied to this company's new grad opening and a recruiter booked a 20-minute first call. You built a distributed storage project at school and interned at a mid-size company last summer.
concessions: 入职日期可以在 6 月到 9 月之间选
Start date anywhere from June to September
搬家补贴 1 万美元，可以换成现金
A $10k relocation package, or cash in its place
notes: 公司为这个岗位办 H-1B（包括新抽签和转签），入职满一年后启动绿卡。流程：本次初筛之后一轮技术电面，再一轮四场的线上 onsite，大约三周走完。

The company sponsors H-1B for this role (new petitions and transfers) and starts a green card after one year. Process: after this call, one technical phone screen, then a four-interview virtual onsite, about three weeks in all.

location: Bay Area, in the office 3 days a week
brief: 一位招聘方在 LinkedIn 上联系你，说有个增长团队在招人。你现在在一家中型公司做了三年后端，带过一个支付功能的重构。
A recruiter reached out on LinkedIn about a growth team. You have three years of backend work at a mid-size company and led a rewrite of its checkout flow.
concessions: 可以把面试安排得更紧，一周内走完
Can squeeze the whole loop into one week
级别在 onsite 后按表现定，可能上调一级
The level is set after the onsite and can go up one
notes: 公司办 H-1B 转签，也接受在 OPT/STEM OPT 期间入职再抽签。流程：一轮技术电面，然后 onsite（两轮编程、一轮系统设计、一轮行为面）。

The company files H-1B transfers and hires people on OPT/STEM OPT who then enter the lottery. Process: one technical phone screen, then an onsite of two coding rounds, one system design and one behavioral.

company: B 轮开发者工具创业公司，约 80 人
Series B developer-tools startup, about 80 people
level: 新毕业生或 1–2 年经验
location: New York, in the office 4 days a week
brief: 你在一个开源项目里用过这家公司的产品，提过两个 PR，然后投了简历。创始团队的招聘负责人约你聊 20 分钟。
You used this company's product in an open-source project and sent it two pull requests, then applied. The founding team's head of recruiting booked 20 minutes with you.
concessions: 期权可以提前行权（early exercise）
Options can be exercised early
离职后行权期可以从 90 天延长到 5 年
Post-departure exercise window can go from 90 days to 5 years
notes: 期权按最近一轮的优先股价折算成美元。公司可以办 H-1B（新抽签也办），绿卡等入职一年后再谈。流程：一轮带回家的小项目，然后和两位工程师、一位创始人各聊一小时。

Options are valued at the last round's preferred price. The company can sponsor H-1B, new petitions included; a green card is discussed after a year. Process: a short take-home, then an hour each with two engineers and a founder.

role: 软件工程师（低延迟 C++）
brief: 你在校招会上和这家公司的工程师聊过，投了简历。你的课程项目做过一个用无锁队列的撮合引擎原型，也参加过 ICPC 区域赛。
You met engineers from this firm at a career fair and applied. Your course project was a matching-engine prototype built on a lock-free queue, and you competed in an ICPC regional.
concessions: 第一年奖金可以写成保底
The first-year bonus can be guaranteed in writing
搬家全包，含第一个月临时住房
Full relocation, including the first month's temporary housing
notes: 公司办 H-1B，有专门的移民律师。流程：一轮在线笔试，两轮技术电面，一天现场面。这家公司对时间线看得很重，希望知道候选人在别处的进度。

The firm sponsors H-1B and has its own immigration counsel. Process: an online test, two technical phone screens, a full on-site day. The firm cares a lot about timelines and wants to know where the candidate is elsewhere.

company: Technology division of a large investment bank
location: New York, in the office 4 days a week
brief: 这是投行技术部门校招的第一轮 HR 电话。你做过一个用 Kafka 处理行情数据的课程项目，对金融系统感兴趣，但没有金融实习。

This is the first HR call of the bank's campus hiring for technology. You built a course project that processed market data through Kafka and you're interested in financial systems, but you have no finance internship.
concessions: 可以优先分到你想去的团队（交易系统或风控）
Priority placement on the team you want (trading systems or risk)
入职日期可以选 7 月或 8 月的培训班
Join the July or the August training class
notes: 大部分团队办 H-1B，个别受监管的团队不办；如果候选人需要担保，招聘方会把他分到能办的团队。流程：一轮 HireVue 视频面，然后 superday（三场连面）。

Most teams sponsor H-1B; a few regulated teams don't, and a candidate who needs sponsorship is routed to teams that do. Process: a recorded video interview, then a superday of three back-to-back interviews.

brief: 你现在在一家咨询公司做数据管道，用 Spark 和 Airflow。招聘方看到你的简历，约了初筛。
You build data pipelines with Spark and Airflow at a consulting firm. The recruiter saw your resume and booked a first call.
concessions: 每年 2000 美元的居家办公补贴
A $2k-a-year home office stipend
入职日期可以推迟到当前项目结束
A start date after your current project ends
notes: 公司办 H-1B 转签，入职 18 个月后启动绿卡。流程：一轮 SQL 和 Python 电面，然后线上 onsite 三场。远程岗位只招美国境内。
The company files H-1B transfers and starts a green card after 18 months. Process: one SQL and Python phone screen, then a three-interview virtual onsite. Remote within the US only.

location: Bay Area, in the office 3 days a week
brief: 你读的是机器学习方向的硕士，论文做的是 CTR 预估里的特征交叉。你在一家初创公司实习时上线过一个排序模型。
You're finishing an ML master's; your thesis is on feature crosses for click-through prediction. At a startup internship you shipped a ranking model.
concessions: 可以先去你感兴趣的出价（bidding）团队
A first placement on the bidding team you're interested in
每年 3000 美元的会议和培训预算
A $3k yearly budget for conferences and courses
notes: 公司办 H-1B，STEM OPT 期间可以入职。流程：一轮编程电面，一轮 ML 基础，然后 onsite（编程、ML 系统设计、行为面）。
The company sponsors H-1B and hires on STEM OPT. Process: a coding phone screen, an ML fundamentals screen, then an onsite of coding, ML system design and behavioral.

company: 后期未上市的自动驾驶公司
role: 高级软件工程师（感知平台）
brief: 你在一家大公司做了六年分布式训练平台，带三个人的小组。这家公司的招聘方主动联系你，说感知团队的数据平台需要人。
You've spent six years on a distributed training platform at a large company and lead a group of three. This company's recruiter reached out: the perception team's data platform needs people.
concessions: 入职后 3 个月内启动绿卡（PERM）
Start the green card (PERM) within 3 months of joining
股票的第一年按月归属，而不是一年 cliff
Monthly vesting in year one instead of a one-year cliff
notes: 股票是未上市公司的 RSU，按最近一轮估值计。公司办 H-1B 转签，高级岗可以入职后很快启动绿卡。流程：一轮技术电面，onsite 五场（含一场架构深挖）。

Equity is private-company RSUs at the last round's valuation. The company files H-1B transfers and can start a green card soon after joining for senior hires. Process: a technical phone screen, then five onsite interviews including an architecture deep dive.

company: 中型上市医疗 SaaS 公司
location: 波士顿，每周到岗 2 天
Boston, in the office 2 days a week
brief: 你在一家保险科技公司做了两年后端，处理过 HIPAA 相关的数据权限。这家公司的招聘方约你聊聊排班系统团队的岗位。
You've done two years of backend work at an insurtech, including HIPAA data-access controls. This company's recruiter wants to talk about a role on the scheduling team.
concessions: 额外 5 天带薪假
Five extra days of paid leave
可以完全远程的前三个月
Fully remote for the first three months
notes: 本财年只办 H-1B 转签；需要新抽签的候选人，招聘方要先问用人经理，不能当场承诺。流程：一轮编程电面，然后 onsite 四场。

This fiscal year the company only files H-1B transfers; for a candidate who needs a new petition the recruiter has to ask the hiring manager first and can't promise anything on the call. Process: a coding phone screen, then four onsite interviews.

company: 中型未上市游戏工作室
role: 客户端 / 玩法工程师
brief: 你用 Unreal 做过两个完整的独立游戏 demo，其中一个在学校的游戏节拿了奖。工作室的招聘方约你聊 20 分钟。
You've made two complete indie game demos in Unreal, and one won your school's game festival. The studio's recruiter booked 20 minutes.
concessions: 可以加入你喜欢的那条新项目组
A spot on the new-title team you're excited about
项目上线奖金写进 offer
A ship bonus written into the offer
notes: 工作室办 H-1B，但流程较慢，需要候选人尽早提供材料。流程：一个玩法小作业，然后和主程、制作人各聊一轮。
The studio sponsors H-1B but its process is slow, so it needs paperwork early. Process: a small gameplay assignment, then a round each with the lead engineer and the producer.

company: 后期未上市的支付金融科技公司
location: New York, in the office 3 days a week
brief: 你在一家银行的支付清算组做了三年，熟悉幂等、对账和双写问题。这家公司的招聘方看到你在技术博客上写的对账文章，联系了你。
You've spent three years on a bank's payments clearing team and know idempotency, reconciliation and dual writes well. This company's recruiter read your blog post on reconciliation and reached out.
concessions: 股票可以选更多 RSU 或更多期权
Equity as more RSUs or more options, your choice
入职日期可以等你拿到当年奖金之后
A start date after your current bonus pays out
notes: 公司办 H-1B 转签和绿卡。流程：一轮编程电面，onsite 四场（编程、系统设计、支付领域深挖、行为面）。
The company files H-1B transfers and green cards. Process: a coding phone screen, then four onsite interviews: coding, system design, a payments deep dive and behavioral.

role: 固件 / 嵌入式软件工程师
location: 奥斯汀，每周到岗 4 天
Austin, in the office 4 days a week
brief: 你本科是电子工程，研究生转了计算机，做过 RTOS 上的驱动开发。招聘方约你聊 SoC 验证软件团队的岗位。
You studied electrical engineering, switched to CS for your master's, and wrote drivers on an RTOS. The recruiter wants to talk about the SoC validation software team.
concessions: 员工购股计划（ESPP）15% 折扣
A 15% discount in the employee stock purchase plan
搬家补贴
A relocation package
notes: 公司办 H-1B 和绿卡，部分出口管制相关的岗位需要额外审批，这个岗位不需要。流程：一轮技术电面，然后现场三场。
The company sponsors H-1B and green cards; some export-controlled roles need extra approval, but this one doesn't. Process: a technical phone screen, then three on-site interviews.

brief: 这家咨询公司在校招，岗位要去客户现场做系统迁移。你做过一个把单体应用拆成服务的课程项目，也在学校 IT 部门打过工。
This consulting firm is hiring on campus for client-site system migrations. You split a monolith into services for a course project and worked part-time in your school's IT office.
concessions: 公司出钱考一张云认证
A paid cloud certification
第一年尽量安排本地项目，少出差
Local projects in year one, less travel
notes: 公司办 H-1B，但客户项目要求美国公民的岗位除外。流程：一轮行为面，一轮案例和技术面。
The firm sponsors H-1B except for client projects that require US citizenship. Process: one behavioral interview, then one case and technical interview.

company: A 轮 AI 基础设施创业公司，约 30 人
Series A AI infrastructure startup, about 30 people
role: 机器学习基础设施工程师
location: 旧金山，每周到岗 5 天
San Francisco, in the office 5 days a week
brief: 你在一家大公司做了一年半推理服务，优化过 GPU 批处理。创始人在推特上看到你写的推理延迟分析，让招聘负责人约你。
You spent a year and a half on inference serving at a large company and tuned GPU batching. A founder saw your write-up on inference latency and had the head of recruiting reach out.
concessions: 期权可以提前行权
Options can be exercised early
每年一次的硬件和学习预算
A yearly hardware and learning budget
notes: 期权按最近一轮估值折算。公司愿意办 H-1B 转签，新抽签也可以，但没有内部移民团队，靠外部律所。流程：一轮系统编程，一轮和创始人聊架构，一天现场结对。

Options are valued at the last round. The company will file H-1B transfers and new petitions but has no in-house immigration team and uses an outside firm. Process: one systems coding round, an architecture talk with a founder, a day of on-site pairing.

role: 高级后端工程师（播放平台）
brief: 你做了七年视频相关的后端，最近两年负责 CDN 调度。招聘方说播放平台在招一位能独当一面的高级工程师。
You have seven years of video backend work and have owned CDN steering for the last two. The recruiter says the playback platform needs a senior engineer who can own an area.
concessions: 薪酬里现金和股票的比例可以自己选
Choose your own split between cash and stock
远程，但每季度一次到总部
Remote, with one visit to headquarters a quarter
notes: 公司办 H-1B 转签和绿卡。流程：一轮和用人经理的电话，然后六场 onsite，其中两场是文化面。
The company files H-1B transfers and green cards. Process: a call with the hiring manager, then six onsite interviews, two of them on culture.

company: 大型上市科技公司的云服务部门
Cloud division of a large public tech company
location: 西雅图，每周到岗 3 天
Seattle, in the office 3 days a week
brief: 你拿到了这份 offer，这家是你的第一选择。你手上还有一家中型上市公司的书面 offer：base 15.5 万、四年股票 10 万、签字费 2 万。
You have this offer and this company is your first choice. You also hold a written offer from a mid-size public company: $155k base, $100k in stock over four years, a $20k sign-on bonus.
concessions: 入职日期在 6 月到 9 月之间任选
A start date anywhere from June to September
搬家补贴从 5000 加到 1 万美元
Relocation raised from $5k to $10k
notes: 给候选人 5 天答复期；候选人有理由时可以延长一周。base 的上限是 16 万，再往上要换级别，你做不到。
Give the candidate 5 days to decide; with a reason, it can stretch by one week. Base tops out at $160k; above that needs a different level, which you can't do.

company: B 轮开发者工具创业公司，约 80 人
Series B developer-tools startup, about 80 people
location: New York, in the office 4 days a week
brief: 这家创业公司是你最想去的。你另有一份大厂 offer，第一年总包约 21 万美元，答复期还有 10 天。股票价值按公司最近一轮估值折算。
This startup is where you most want to go. You also hold a big-tech offer worth about $210k in the first year, with 10 days left to answer. Stock is valued at the company's last round.
concessions: 期权可以提前行权
Early exercise of the options
离职后行权期延长到 5 年
A 5-year post-departure exercise window
notes: 给 3 天答复期，说董事会下周要定本季度的期权池。现金很紧：base 最多加 1 万，愿意多给期权。
Give 3 days, saying the board sets this quarter's option pool next week. Cash is tight: base can rise by $10k at most; you'd rather give more options.

role: 软件工程师（低延迟 C++）
brief: 你刚拿到这份 offer。另一家交易公司的终面你上周面完了，对方说 10 天内给结果。奖金一栏是第一年的目标奖金。
You just got this offer. You finished the final round at another trading firm last week and they said results come within 10 days. The bonus line is the first-year target.
concessions: 第一年奖金保底 10 万
A guaranteed $100k first-year bonus
答复期最多延长到 7 天
The deadline can stretch to 7 days at most
notes: 开场就说这份 offer 48 小时内有效。候选人说出另一家的具体时间线后，才可以延长，最多 7 天。base 几乎不动，主要在签字费和保底奖金上让步。

Open by saying the offer is good for 48 hours. Extend only once the candidate gives the other firm's timeline, and to 7 days at most. Base barely moves; give ground on sign-on and the guaranteed bonus.

location: 湾区，需要从奥斯汀搬家
brief: 你现在年薪 16.5 万，还有约 6 万美元没归属的股票，跳槽就拿不到了。湾区的生活成本比奥斯汀高不少。
You earn $165k now and would forfeit about $60k of unvested stock by leaving. The Bay Area costs a lot more to live in than Austin.
concessions: 搬家补贴从 1.5 万加到 2.5 万
Relocation raised from $15k to $25k
签字费分两年发，第二年再发一笔
A sign-on split over two years, with a second payment in year two
notes: 给一周答复期。候选人提到放弃的未归属股票时，可以用签字费补，但要对方给出具体数字。
Give a week to decide. If the candidate raises the unvested stock they'd forfeit, cover it with sign-on, but only once they give a specific figure.

company: Technology division of a large investment bank
location: New York, in the office 4 days a week
brief: 你没有别的 offer，另外两家还在初筛阶段。你查过公开数据：同城同级别的银行技术岗 base 大多在 12 万到 13.5 万之间。奖金是看表现的，不保证。
You have no other offer; two other processes are at the first-call stage. Public data you found puts same-level bank tech roles in the city at $120k to $135k base. The bonus is discretionary.
concessions: 优先分到你想去的团队
Priority placement on the team you want
入职日期在 7 月和 8 月的培训班之间选
The July or the August training class
notes: 给一周答复期。校招的薪资带很死，base 最多加 5000，强调这是统一标准；签字费有一点空间。头衔不能改。
Give a week. Campus bands are rigid: base can rise by $5k at most, and you stress that the scale is uniform; sign-on has a little room. The title can't change.

company: 后期未上市的自动驾驶公司
level: offer 上写的是中级（SWE II），你有 6 年经验
Offered at mid-level (SWE II); you have 6 years
brief: 面试反馈说你系统设计表现很好，但 offer 给的是中级。你另有一份高级岗的书面 offer：base 24 万、四年股票 45 万。股票是未上市公司的 RSU。

Your feedback said your system design was strong, but the offer is mid-level. You hold a written senior offer elsewhere: $240k base, $450k in stock over four years. Equity here is private-company RSUs.
concessions: 可以把 offer 送回定级委员会复核，有竞争 offer 时大概率上调到高级
Send the offer back to the leveling committee; with a competing offer it likely becomes senior
第一年股票按月归属
Monthly vesting in year one
notes: 中级的上限是 base 21 万、股票 30 万。只有候选人拿出具体的高级 offer 并要求复核定级时，才说可以送复核；复核通过后可以给到上面的底线。给 5 天答复期。

Mid-level tops out at $210k base and $300k stock. Only when the candidate cites a specific senior offer and asks for a re-level do you offer the committee review; after it passes you can go to the limits above. Give 5 days.

location: Bay Area, in the office 3 days a week
brief: 你还有一家大厂的书面 offer：base 17 万、四年股票 20 万、签字费 5 万。你更喜欢这家的团队，但两边的钱差得不少。
You also hold a big-tech written offer: $170k base, $200k in stock over four years, a $50k sign-on. You like this team better, but the money is well apart.
concessions: 每年 3000 美元的会议预算
A $3k yearly conference budget
签字费可以一次性在入职时发
The whole sign-on paid at start
notes: 给 4 天答复期。会问竞争 offer 的具体构成，并且要求看书面 offer。签字费最好谈，base 和股票加一点就到顶。
Give 4 days. Ask what the competing offer is made of and ask to see it in writing. Sign-on is the easiest lever; base and stock top out after a small bump.

brief: 你现在年薪 14 万。除了这份 offer，一家金融科技公司的招聘方刚联系过你，还没开始面。
You earn $140k now. Besides this offer, a fintech recruiter just reached out, but you haven't started interviewing there.
concessions: 每年 2000 美元居家办公补贴
A $2k yearly home office stipend
额外 5 天带薪假
Five extra days of paid leave
notes: 给一周答复期。会问候选人现在的薪资；候选人如果不说也不要逼。远程岗按全美统一的薪资带，不按城市调整。
Give a week. Ask about current pay, and don't press if the candidate declines to say. Remote roles use one national band, not city-adjusted.

company: 中型未上市游戏工作室
role: 客户端 / 玩法工程师
brief: 你很想去这家工作室。你查到洛杉矶同类岗位的新毕业生 base 中位数大约 13 万，这份 offer 偏低。你没有别的 offer。
You really want to join this studio. Data you found puts the median new-grad base for similar roles in Los Angeles at about $130k, so this offer is low. You have no other offer.
concessions: 项目上线奖金写进 offer
A ship bonus written into the offer
半年后做一次薪资复核
A pay review after six months

Give a week. Lean on 'people make games for love' to hold the number. When the candidate brings market data, raise base or add a sign-on.

location: 波士顿，每周到岗 2 天

Give 5 days, stretching to 10 once the candidate shares the other company's timeline. Base tops out at $160k; beyond that use sign-on and stock.

Equity as more RSUs or more options

notes: 先给 3 天答复期。候选人说出另一家 4 天后过期，你可以说会尽快在 48 小时内给修改版。未上市股票不好比，会被要求解释估值，答得出最近一轮的价格就行。

Start with 3 days. When the candidate says the other offer expires in 4 days, promise a revised offer within 48 hours. Private stock is hard to compare and you'll be asked about the valuation; giving the last round's price is enough.
